svg.title: Who reaches the saved accounts
svg.desc: The saved accounts sit in chrome.storage.local, which only the extension's own contexts can read, the service worker and its pages: the popup, the options page and the switcher in its frame. Their tokens and remembered passwords are sealed there with AES-GCM; the key can't be exported and sits in the IndexedDB of the extension, which only the service worker uses. content.js runs inside the Autodarts page and can't read the storage. It may ask the service worker only what its button shows, takes requests only from this extension and writes into the page's session only a token. The service worker takes a request to see or change the accounts only from a page of this extension. Its content security policy lets it connect to api.autodarts.com alone, and the browser blocks any other host.
